fields.name: branchType
fields.doc: PHARMACY | HOSPITAL_PHARMACY | DISTRIBUTION_CENTRE | HEAD_OFFICE | CLINIC

fields.name: locationType
fields.doc: What the location is for. Put-away and picking both read this, and stock in a non-sellable area (QUARANTINE, DAMAGED, RECALL_HOLD) is never a picking candidate. GENERAL | PICKING | BULK | RECEIVING | DISPATCH | STAGING | DOCK | QUARANTINE | DAMAGED | CONTROLLED | RETURNS | RECALL_HOLD | COLD | FROZEN

fields.name: storageCondition
fields.doc: Storage environment this location provides, matched against the product's requirement before anything is put away here.

fields.name: capacityUnits
fields.doc: Capacity in base units and kilograms. Null means unmetered.

fields.name: barcode
fields.doc: Scannable label on the shelf edge (§5: feature 227).

fields.name: pickSequence
fields.doc: Pick sequence within the zone, so a pick list walks the aisle in order.

fields.name: taskType
fields.doc: PUTAWAY | PICK | REPLENISH | MOVE | COUNT | PACK | DISPATCH

fields.name: status
fields.doc: PENDING | ASSIGNED | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | SHORT

fields.name: suggestedLocationId
fields.doc: Where the system recommended the stock should go, kept alongside where it actually went so directed put-away can be measured rather than assumed.

fields.name: referenceType
fields.doc: The document that caused the work: GOODS_RECEIPT | TRANSFER | SALE | PRESCRIPTION | COUNT | REPLENISHMENT

fields.name: strategy
fields.doc: WAVE | ZONE | BATCH — how the lines were grouped.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: PLANNED | RELEASED | PICKING | PICKED | PACKED | DISPATCHED | CANCELLED

fields.name: zoneId
fields.doc: Set for a zone wave.

fields.name: referenceType
fields.doc: TRANSFER | SALE | RETURN

fields.name: status
fields.doc: PACKING | PACKED | VERIFIED | STAGED | DISPATCHED | CANCELLED

fields.name: stagingLocationId
fields.doc: Where the package waits between packing and collection.

fields.name: departureTempC
fields.doc: Cold-chain shipments record the temperature the box left at.

fields.name: verifiedQuantity
fields.doc: Set once the line has been scanned during packing verification.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: INBOUND | OUTBOUND | BOTH

fields.name: registrationNumber
fields.doc: Regulatory registration (§1: features 15-16). Expiry is tracked so a product whose licence has lapsed can be reported before it is ordered.

fields.name: maxQuantityPerSale
fields.doc: The most that may go out on one sale, for products a pharmacy is required to limit — pseudoephedrine and codeine preparations being the usual ones. Null means no limit.

fields.name: maxDailyDose
fields.doc: The most that may be taken in 24 hours, in base units. Used to warn when a prescribed regimen exceeds it.

fields.name: renalCaution
fields.doc: Cautions surfaced at the point of dispensing. Advisory: they prompt the pharmacist to think, and are never a substitute for their judgement.

fields.name: auxiliaryLabels
fields.doc: Auxiliary label text: "Take with food", "May cause drowsiness".

fields.name: isAgeRestricted
fields.doc: Requires the cashier to confirm the buyer's age before it can be sold.

fields.name: saleClassification
fields.doc: POM | OTC | PHARMACY_ONLY | HOSPITAL_ONLY

fields.name: pregnancyInfo
fields.doc: Free text from the approved product information. Never generated.

fields.name: maxExcursionMinutes
fields.doc: How long this product may sit outside its storage range before the excursion needs a QA disposition.

fields.name: purchaseMultiple
fields.doc: Orders are rounded up to a multiple of this. 0 disables the rule.

fields.name: procurementRestricted
fields.doc: Procurement is blocked outside the emergency workflow when set.

fields.name: seasonalProfile
fields.doc: Per-month demand multipliers, e.g. {"1":0.8,"7":1.6}. Used by forecasting.

fields.name: targetMarginPct
fields.doc: Target gross margin, used to flag under-priced lines. Advisory only.

fields.name: factorToBase
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(18, 6) // how many base units in one of these

fields.name: unitCode
fields.attributes: // barcode may identify a carton rather than a tablet

fields.name: strengthValue
fields.doc: Numeric strength, kept separate from its unit so it can be compared.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: ACTIVE | EXCIPIENT

fields.name: dataType
fields.doc: TEXT | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | DATE | SELECT

fields.name: relationType
fields.doc: FAMILY | VARIANT | ALTERNATIVE_BRAND | GENERIC_EQUIVALENT | SUBSTITUTE

fields.name: discountPercent
fields.doc: Applied when no price-list line matches. Expressed as a fraction.

fields.name: listType
fields.doc: RETAIL | WHOLESALE | INSURANCE | CONTRACT | PROMOTIONAL

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Higher wins when several lists match the same sale.

fields.name: minQuantity
fields.doc: Quantity break: the line applies from this quantity upward.

fields.name: effectiveFrom
fields.doc: Overrides the list window for one product.

fields.name: riskLevel
fields.doc: Risk rating (§7: feature 341), set by a buyer or derived from the KPIs below: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL

fields.name: creditLimit
fields.doc: Credit the supplier extends, checked when an invoice is approved (§7: 312).

fields.name: status
fields.doc: IN_STOCK | DISPENSED | SOLD | TRANSFERRED | RETURNED | RECALLED | DESTROYED

fields.name: warehouseId
fields.doc: Where the pack physically is, so a transfer moves the serial with it.

fields.name: lastReferenceType
fields.doc: The document that last moved it, for a trace that has to reach a person.

fields.name: eventType
fields.doc: RECEIVED | DISPENSED | SOLD | TRANSFERRED | RETURNED | RECALLED | DESTROYED | CORRECTED

fields.name: performedById
fields.doc: Who did it, and why where a reason is required.

fields.name: balanceId
fields.doc: The exact inventory_balances row this reservation incremented.  Balances are keyed by product + batch + warehouse + location, so one batch in two bins has two rows. Without this, reserving and releasing each picked a row with findFirst and could touch different ones, leaving the reserved figure drifting. Nullable only for rows written before this column existed; those fall back to the old lookup.

fields.name: damageType
fields.attributes: // BREAKAGE | CONTAMINATION | PACKAGING | HANDLING | TEMPERATURE | PEST | OTHER

fields.name: supplierInvoiceNo
fields.doc: The number printed on the supplier's own invoice.

fields.name: orderedQty
fields.doc: Populated by the three-way match so variances are visible per line.

fields.name: driverName
fields.doc: Logistics (§11: features 528-530). Who is carrying it, how it is tracked, and when it is expected — without which a late transfer cannot be noticed.

fields.name: isBlind
fields.doc: Blind count (§10: feature 453): the counter is not shown the system quantity, so they record what is on the shelf rather than confirming what the system already believes.

fields.name: isFrozen
fields.doc: Freeze (§10: feature 471): while set, the ledger refuses movements of the counted positions, so the count is of a stationary shelf.

fields.name: lossType
fields.doc: What kind of loss this was (§10: features 484-488). Recorded per line because one count can find damage on one shelf and theft on another: SHRINKAGE | DAMAGE | THEFT | MISPLACEMENT | EXPIRY | COUNTING_ERROR | SUPPLIER_SHORTAGE | UNKNOWN

fields.name: patientType
fields.doc: INDIVIDUAL | CORPORATE | INSTITUTIONAL

fields.name: communicationPrefs
fields.doc: {"sms":true,"email":false,"whatsapp":false} — respected before any send.

fields.name: loyaltyTier
fields.doc: NONE | BRONZE | SILVER | GOLD

fields.name: isAnonymized
fields.doc: Set by the anonymization workflow. The row is kept so historical dispensing stays auditable; the identifying fields are cleared (§14).

fields.name: anonymizedReason
fields.doc: Why the record was anonymised, kept because the act itself is auditable even though the identifying data is gone.

fields.name: mergedIntoId
fields.doc: Points at the surviving record after a duplicate merge.

fields.name: consentType
fields.doc: DATA_PROCESSING | MARKETING | SMS | EMAIL | DATA_SHARING | RESEARCH

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Version of the consent text that was agreed to.

fields.name: method
fields.doc: How consent was captured: IN_PERSON | PHONE | ONLINE | PAPER

fields.name: validUntil
fields.doc: After this date the prescription may not be dispensed. Prescriptions do expire, and one written two years ago is not a licence to hand out medicine today.

fields.name: isUrgent
fields.doc: Moves the prescription up the queue. Set by the pharmacist, not the patient, so "urgent" keeps meaning something.

fields.name: readyAt
fields.doc: When everything on it was made up and is waiting to be collected.

fields.name: refillOfId
fields.doc: The prescription this one was issued as a repeat of. A refill is a new prescription rather than a counter on the old one, so each supply keeps its own dates, its own items and its own audit trail.

fields.name: allowSubstitution
fields.doc: Whether the pharmacist may supply a generic equivalent. Prescribers write "do not substitute" for a reason, so it is recorded per line.

fields.name: counsellingNotes
fields.doc: What the pharmacist actually told the patient. A counselling record that only says "counselled" records nothing.

fields.name: witnessedById
fields.doc: The second person present for a controlled-drug supply.

fields.name: overriddenWarnings
fields.doc: Clinical warnings that were raised and overridden, with the reason for each. An override with no reason is indistinguishable from not looking.

fields.name: substitutedForProductId
fields.doc: Set when the pharmacist supplied an equivalent instead of the product the prescriber wrote. The prescribed product is kept, not overwritten, so the record still shows what was asked for as well as what was handed over.

fields.name: closedById
fields.doc: Who closed it, which need not be who opened it on a shift handover.

fields.name: denominations
fields.doc: The drawer counted note by note: {"100": 4, "50": 12, ...}. Kept because "the drawer was 200 short" is a different investigation from "there were no fifties in it".

fields.name: isBlindClose
fields.doc: A blind close hides the expected figure until the count is submitted, so the cashier counts what is there rather than what the screen predicts.

fields.name: movementType
fields.doc: DROP | PAYOUT | FLOAT_IN | PICKUP

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Always positive. The type decides the direction.

fields.name: witnessedById
fields.doc: Who witnessed it. A drop to the safe with no second person is how money goes missing with nobody accountable.

fields.name: lastCalibratedAt
fields.doc: Calibration is what makes a reading evidence rather than a number (§27: features 897-899). A sensor past its calibration due date is still read - refusing readings would blind the cold room - but every excursion decision made on it is marked as resting on an uncalibrated instrument.

fields.name: validUntil
fields.doc: When this certificate stops being valid.

fields.name: certificateNo
fields.doc: The certificate number issued by the calibrating body.

fields.name: referenceTempC
fields.doc: Reference reading vs sensor reading at calibration, in degrees Celsius.

fields.name: result
fields.doc: PASS | ADJUSTED | FAIL — a failed calibration is recorded, not discarded.

fields.name: workType
fields.doc: PREVENTIVE | CORRECTIVE | BATTERY | REPLACEMENT | INSPECTION

fields.name: nextDueAt
fields.doc: When the next service of this kind falls due.

fields.name: tookOffline
fields.doc: True when the equipment was out of service while this was done.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Short heading. The description carries the detail.

fields.name: severity
fields.doc: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL

fields.name: sourceType
fields.doc: What raised this incident: AUTOMATION | EXCURSION | RECEIVING | MANUAL. Kept so an automatically raised incident is traceable to its rule and is not opened again on the next run.

fields.name: entryType
fields.attributes: // RECEIPT | DISPENSE | RETURN | DESTRUCTION | REVERSAL | ADJUSTMENT

fields.name: providerRef
fields.doc: The provider's own message id, so a delivery can be traced at their end.

fields.name: entityType
fields.attributes: // SUPPLIER | PRODUCT | PURCHASE_ORDER | GRN | PRESCRIPTION | RECALL | DISPOSAL

fields.name: secret
fields.doc: HMAC signing secret. Returned once at registration, never read back.

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: SCHEDULED | MANUAL

fields.name: status
fields.doc: RUNNING | SUCCESS | FAILED

fields.name: type
fields.doc: ASSET | LIABILITY | EQUITY | INCOME | EXPENSE

fields.name: subType
fields.doc: Narrower classification for reporting, e.g. CURRENT_ASSET, COST_OF_SALES.

fields.name: systemKey
fields.doc: Stable handle the posting rules use, so renaming or renumbering an account never breaks posting: INVENTORY_ASSET, COGS, VAT_INPUT, VAT_OUTPUT, ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE, CASH, SALES_REVENUE, INVENTORY_WRITE_OFF, INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT, PURCHASE_DISCOUNT, FREIGHT, WITHHOLDING_TAX, STOCK_IN_TRANSIT.

fields.name: isSystem
fields.doc: A system account cannot be deleted, because posting rules point at it.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.doc: What produced this entry: GOODS_RECEIPT | SALE | DISPENSING | ADJUSTMENT | DISPOSAL | DAMAGE | TRANSFER | SUPPLIER_INVOICE | PAYMENT | CREDIT_NOTE | DEBIT_NOTE | MANUAL

fields.name: status
fields.doc: DRAFT | POSTED | REVERSED

fields.name: reversalOfId
fields.doc: A posted entry is never edited or deleted; it is reversed by another entry that points back at it (§53 soft-delete policy).

fields.name: productId
fields.doc: Kept for inventory reporting, never for driving stock.

fields.name: transactionId
fields.doc: The receipt that created this layer.

fields.name: noteType
fields.doc: CREDIT | DEBIT

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: CUSTOMER | SUPPLIER

fields.name: referenceType
fields.doc: What it adjusts: SUPPLIER_INVOICE | SALE | RETURN

fields.name: status
fields.doc: DRAFT | ISSUED | APPLIED | CANCELLED

fields.name: status
fields.doc: OPEN | CLOSED

fields.name: triggerType
fields.doc: What the rule looks at: BATCH_EXPIRY | STOCK_LEVEL | TEMPERATURE_EXCURSION | PURCHASE_ORDER_OVERDUE | STOCK_VARIANCE | CONTROLLED_VARIANCE | SUPPLIER_LICENCE | QUARANTINED_STOCK | FAILED_QUALITY_INSPECTION

fields.name: conditions
fields.doc: { match: 'ALL' | 'ANY', conditions: [{ field, operator, value }] }

fields.name: actions
fields.doc: [{ type, params }] — executed in order for every matching subject.

fields.name: escalations
fields.doc: [{ afterHours, actions }] — run if the subject still matches later.

fields.name: branchId
fields.doc: Restrict the rule to one branch. Null means the whole organization.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Higher runs first when several rules share a trigger.

fields.name: cooldownHours
fields.doc: Suppress a repeat action on the same subject inside this window.

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: MANUAL | SCHEDULED | PREVIEW

fields.name: sample
fields.doc: A sample of what matched, so a run can be explained without re-running it.

fields.name: subjectType
fields.doc: BATCH | BALANCE | EXCURSION | PURCHASE_ORDER | COUNT | REGISTER | SUPPLIER

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Which escalation step has been reached; 0 is the original action.

fields.name: nextDueAt
fields.doc: When the next escalation step becomes due. Null when there is none left.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: OPEN | ESCALATED | RESOLVED

fields.name: prefix
fields.doc: First characters of the key, shown in the list so a key can be identified without being revealed.

fields.name: scopes
fields.doc: Permission codes this key may exercise.

fields.name: branchId
fields.doc: Restrict to one branch; null is organization-wide.

fields.name: rateLimit
fields.doc: Requests per minute. 0 means the global limit applies.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: INBOUND | OUTBOUND

fields.name: resourceType
fields.doc: Patient | Practitioner | Organization | Medication | MedicationRequest | MedicationDispense

fields.name: externalId
fields.doc: The resource id in the external system.

fields.name: internalId
fields.doc: The record this mapped to or from, once resolved.

fields.name: fhirVersion
fields.doc: The FHIR release the payload was interpreted as, e.g. "4.0.1".

fields.name: status
fields.doc: RECEIVED | MAPPED | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | FAILED

fields.name: issues
fields.doc: Validation problems, one per line, when the payload was rejected.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.doc: Supplied by the caller so a retry cannot create the record twice.

fields.name: dataSource
fields.doc: Key from the report catalogue, e.g. inventory_balances.

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Column keys, in display order.

fields.name: filters
fields.doc: [{ field, operator, value }]

fields.name: sort
fields.doc: [{ field, direction }]

fields.name: aggregates
fields.doc: COUNT | SUM | AVG | MIN | MAX per column, when grouped.

fields.name: visualization
fields.doc: TABLE | BAR | LINE | PIE

fields.name: isShared
fields.doc: Shared reports are visible to everyone who can read the data source.

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: Cron expression for scheduled delivery, or null for on demand.

fields.name: recipients
fields.doc: Role codes the scheduled run is delivered to.

fields.name: entityType
fields.doc: Key from the import catalogue: products, suppliers, patients, barcodes, price_list, opening_stock.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: UPLOADED | VALIDATED | IMPORTING | COMPLETED | PARTIAL | FAILED | ROLLED_BACK

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Uploaded column name -> target field.

fields.name: fileErrors
fields.doc: Whole-file problems: a missing required column, an unreadable file.

fields.name: raw
fields.doc: The cells exactly as uploaded, so an error file can reproduce them.

fields.name: mapped
fields.doc: The values after mapping and coercion.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: PENDING | VALID | INVALID | IMPORTED | FAILED | SKIPPED | ROLLED_BACK

fields.name: errors
fields.doc: [{ field, message }]

fields.name: entityId
fields.doc: What this row created or updated, so it can be undone.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: CREATED | UPDATED — an update is not undone by deleting the record.
